specs.Metrics Measured: Blood Oxygen (SpO2), Body Temperature, Calories Burned, Heart Rate, Sleep Duration
specs.Target Audience: Boys, Girls, Men, Unisex Adults, Unisex Youth
specs.Function: Pedometer, Sleep Monitor, Sports Tracker, Sedentary Reminder, Call Notification

features: AI HEALTH SCORE EVERY DAY: Flex's AI turns your data into one clear daily health score with a simple headline. It combines your activity, sitting time, sleep stages, sleep quality, HRV and resting heart rate to show how well your body has recovered. You'll know whether to push hard or rest today.

ADVANCED ACTIVITY & HEALTH TRACKING: Flex continuously brings together key health and fitness data including steps, calories, workout duration, heart rate, HRV, SpO2, sleep and stress, giving you a more complete picture of your everyday wellness.

100+ SPORTS MODES: Track running, walking, cycling, gym, yoga and 100+ more activities from the app. Steps, calories and duration are recorded automatically. IP68 water resistance handles sweat, rain and handwashing. Remove it before swimming or hot showers.

COMPLETE HEALTH TRACKING: This fitness tracker with heart rate monitor checks your heart rate automatically every 30 minutes and tracks HRV, SpO2, stress and deep and light sleep. Built-in menstrual cycle tracking makes it a great fitness tracker for women too.
UP TO 30 DAYS BATTERY: One 2–3 hour magnetic charge lasts up to 30 days (45 days on standby). The band stores 14 days of data, so nothing is lost even if your phone isn't nearby.

SMART ALERTS, ZERO DISTRACTIONS: You get vibration alerts for calls and messages, a silent alarm, sitting reminders, find-my-band and camera control. With no screen and a soft nylon strap, it's light and comfortable enough to wear all day and night.
